transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. Thank you for making time for our arranged telephone discussion. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak?

Office quite quiet now, so this timing works well lah. Got my details in front of me. My FIN is T three double nine two four three seven L. My date of birth is the eighteenth of August nineteen fifty-three.

Thank you. We can keep the appointment focused, with time for you to finish speaking before I move on. How is your work schedule looking?

Trying to make it quieter lah. My family can handle more of the daily business now. No need for me to sit through every discussion already. Still getting used to leaving the office without checking everything myself.

That sounds like a significant change to your routine. For future appointments, would you prefer that I send a message beforehand rather than call unexpectedly?

Message first would be better ah. Then I can find somewhere quiet instead of talking halfway through work. Short calls like this quite convenient; travelling in just for a conversation takes up the afternoon.

I will note that contact preference. Turning to today's discussion, Your objective is to build a diversified source of investment income over a longer investment horizon; that is the objective I am using for this discussion. I recommend Orion Global Income Fund because its income-oriented bond portfolio supports your income objective and spreads exposure across issuers. That portfolio approach also fits your longer investment horizon.

Let me think a bit first ah. No hurry on my side; the office matters can wait until we finish talking.

With Orion Global Income Fund, rising interest rates can reduce the market value of the bonds it holds, which can lower the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could lower the value of your investment in this fund?

Yes, I understand. Rates go up, the bonds can fall in value, so my fund units can be worth less.

The transaction charge is 1,500 renminbi. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses. The value can fluctuate; I can accept that. For settling the charge only, use Chinese yuan, not for the investment itself.

I will give you space to set out your instruction in your own words. There is no need to compress everything into a quick reply.

Got my notes here, so no need to rush lah. For this investment, I want Orion Global Income Fund. I want to buy, ah. The investment itself, use Japanese yen. The amount I want to invest is 50,000,000. The quantity I want is 1,000 units. For the order type, I was going to say— Wait, use a limit order, with a maximum price per unit of 50,000 Japanese yen.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 1,000 units of Orion Global Income Fund for 50,000,000 Japanese yen, using a limit order with a maximum price per unit of 50,000 Japanese yen. Is that your instruction, and do you authorise me to place it?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please place the order as you read it back. My side quite quiet still, so I can stay on the line if you need a moment lah.

Thank you. I have what I need from this conversation. I will handle the administration and send the documentation through our usual secure channel.

That saves me a trip down lah. The message notification quite useful; otherwise I might leave the documents sitting there while I'm busy at work.

Please use the secure channel if an administrative question comes up when you review the documents. We can arrange a telephone appointment if you would rather speak.

Can. Much easier than trying to catch each other between meetings. These days I want to leave some space in the diary, not fill it straight away again.

Of course. Thank you for your time today, Adrian Lim. I hope the rest of your afternoon is peaceful.

Thanks, Rachel Tan. Going to leave the office while things still quiet lah. Enjoy the rest of your day too.
